FRANCHISE DISCLOSURE DOCUMENT

TIDEWATER BOWL COMPANY, LLC
a Virginia limited liability company
4400 Chesapeake Avenue, Suite 210
Norfolk, Virginia 23510
(757) 555-0142
franchising@tidewaterbowl.com
www.tidewaterbowl.com

The franchise offered is for the operation of a Tidewater Bowl fast-casual grain-bowl restaurant.

The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Tidewater Bowl franchise ranges from $412,500 to $786,000, which includes $47,500 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliates.

This disclosure document summarizes certain provisions of your franchise agreement and other information in plain English. Read this disclosure document and all accompanying agreements carefully. You must receive this disclosure document at least 14 calendar days before you sign a binding agreement with, or make any payment to, the franchisor or an affiliate in connection with the proposed franchise sale.

Note, however, that no government agency has verified the information contained in this document.

You may wish to receive your disclosure document in another format that is more convenient for you. To discuss the availability of disclosures in different formats, contact Renata Kowalczyk, Director of Franchise Development, at the address and telephone number above.

The terms of your contract will govern your franchise relationship. Don't rely on the disclosure document alone to understand your contract. Read all of your contract carefully. Show your contract and this disclosure document to an advisor, like a lawyer or an accountant.

Buying a franchise is a complex investment. The information in this disclosure document can help you make up your mind. More information on franchising, such as "A Consumer's Guide to Buying a Franchise," which can help you understand how to use this disclosure document, is available from the Federal Trade Commission. You can contact the FTC at 1-877-FTC-HELP or by writing to the FTC at 600 Pennsylvania Avenue, NW, Washington, DC 20580. You can also visit the FTC's home page at www.ftc.gov for additional information.

Issuance date: March 31, 2026

ITEM 1. THE FRANCHISOR, AND ANY PARENTS, PREDECESSORS, AND AFFILIATES

To simplify the language in this disclosure document, "we," "us," and "our" mean Tidewater Bowl Company, LLC, the franchisor. "You" means the person who buys the franchise. If you are a corporation, partnership, or limited liability company, "you" also includes your owners.

We were organized as a Virginia limited liability company on August 2, 2018, and began offering franchises on January 4, 2022. We have never conducted business under any other name. Our parent is Chesapeake Hospitality Group, Inc., a Delaware corporation with its principal business address at 900 Waterside Drive, Norfolk, Virginia 23510. We have no predecessors. Our affiliate, Tidewater Supply Company, LLC, sells proprietary sauces and packaging to our franchisees and has done so since 2022; it does not offer franchises in any line of business.

ITEM 2. BUSINESS EXPERIENCE

Renata Kowalczyk, Chief Executive Officer. Ms. Kowalczyk has served as our Chief Executive Officer since January 2019. From March 2012 to December 2018 she was Vice President of Operations for Harborline Restaurant Group, Baltimore, Maryland.

Ellis Danforth, Chief Financial Officer. Mr. Danforth has served as our Chief Financial Officer since June 2021. From July 2015 to May 2021 he was Controller for Piedmont Food Concepts, Richmond, Virginia.

ITEM 3. LITIGATION

No litigation is required to be disclosed in this Item.

ITEM 4. BANKRUPTCY

No bankruptcy is required to be disclosed in this Item.

ITEM 5. INITIAL FEES

You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $42,500 when you sign the franchise agreement. The initial franchise fee is uniform for all franchisees who signed agreements during our most recent fiscal year and is not refundable under any circumstance. If you purchase a multi-unit development agreement, you must pay a development fee equal to $42,500 for the first restaurant plus $21,250 for each additional restaurant you commit to develop, payable when you sign the development agreement.

ITEM 6. OTHER FEES

You must pay a continuing royalty of six percent (6%) of Gross Sales, payable weekly by electronic funds transfer, and a brand fund contribution of two percent (2%) of Gross Sales, payable on the same schedule. Late payments bear interest at the lesser of eighteen percent (18%) per year or the maximum rate permitted by law. A transfer fee of $12,500 is due on any transfer of the franchise. A renewal fee of $10,000 is due on any renewal of the franchise agreement.

ITEM 7. ESTIMATED INITIAL INVESTMENT

YOUR ESTIMATED INITIAL INVESTMENT

Initial franchise fee: $42,500 (payable in a lump sum, to us, when you sign the franchise agreement).
Leasehold improvements: $185,000 to $410,000 (paid as incurred, to contractors).
Equipment, furniture and fixtures: $118,000 to $196,000 (paid as incurred, to vendors).
Signage: $14,000 to $28,000.
Opening inventory: $11,000 to $17,000.
Insurance deposits: $4,500 to $9,500.
Training expenses (travel and living): $6,500 to $18,000.
Additional funds — 3 months: $31,000 to $65,000.
TOTAL ESTIMATED INITIAL INVESTMENT: $412,500 to $786,000.

ITEM 8. RESTRICTIONS ON SOURCES OF PRODUCTS AND SERVICES

You must purchase proprietary sauces, seasoning blends, and branded packaging exclusively from our affiliate Tidewater Supply Company, LLC or from suppliers we designate. In our most recent fiscal year, our affiliate derived revenue of $2,140,000 from required purchases by franchisees, which was 11% of our system-wide revenue.

ITEM 19. FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE REPRESENTATIONS

The FTC's Franchise Rule permits a franchisor to provide information about the actual or potential financial performance of its franchised and/or franchisor-owned outlets, if there is a reasonable basis for the information, and if the information is included in the disclosure document. Financial performance information that differs from that included in Item 19 may be given only if: (1) a franchisor provides the actual records of an existing outlet you are considering buying; or (2) a franchisor supplements the information provided in this Item 19, for example, by providing information about possible performance at a particular location or under particular circumstances.

The following table sets forth the average, median, highest, and lowest annual Gross Sales of the 38 franchised restaurants that were open and operating for the entire twelve months ended December 31, 2025. Of those 38 restaurants, 16 (42%) attained or exceeded the average.

Average annual Gross Sales: $1,148,000. Median: $1,092,000. Highest: $1,914,000. Lowest: $671,000.

Some outlets have sold this amount. Your individual results may differ. There is no assurance that you will sell as much.

Written substantiation for the financial performance representation in this Item will be made available to you on reasonable request.

Outlets reacquired by franchisor: 1. Outlets ceased operations for other reasons: 0. Franchised outlets at the end of 2025: 39. Company-owned outlets at the end of 2025: 3.
